C dep001.ad-need OL DEP-001,DEP-002 MUST ;; State the concrete current requirement and use the approved technology when one exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.ad-replace-reserved OL ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Replacing an approved technology is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.ad-conditional OL DEP-011,DEP-016,TST-007 MUST ;; Conditional technologies are added only when their capability is needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.ad-mapster OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Mapping uses Mapster with Mapster.DependencyInjection when mapping is needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep020.ad-resilience OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience / Microsoft.Extensions.Resilience are the resilience packages when resilience is required; direct Polly is an explicit documented exception. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ad-no-deprecated-resilience EX DEP-020,DEP-004 MUST_NOT ;; The deprecated Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Polly / Polly.Extensions.Http integrations are never added. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete deny rule not in the oracle.
C dep017.ad-asp-versioning OL DEP-017 DEFAULT ;; Asp.Versioning.Mvc (+ ApiExplorer) only once Controller API versioning has been adopted. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.latest-stable OL DEP-003 MUST ;; Determine the latest stable version compatible with framework/runtime and peers, verified from the registry, never from memory. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep003.no-prerelease OL DEP-003 MUST_NOT ;; No prerelease or floating versions unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; Explicit request. ;;
C dep004.deprecation OL DEP-004 MUST ;; Check whether the exact package/version is deprecated. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep004.vulnerability OL DEP-004 MUST ;; Check known vulnerability information (dotnet package list --vulnerable --include-transitive, frontend audit command). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep004.license OL DEP-004 MUST ;; Verify the license of the exact selected version from official registry metadata (and upstream when necessary). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep005.permissive OL DEP-005 ALLOWED ;; Permissive licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD) are acceptable without approval; free to download does not make a package acceptable. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep005.license-gate OL DEP-005 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not install paid/commercial or materially restrictive/unclassifiable licenses automatically; present the concern and alternatives without silent substitution; say so when no free alternative exists. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ad-no-legal-conclusions EX DEP-005 MUST_NOT ;; Make no legal conclusions beyond the published license information. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in DEP-005.
C dep006.ad-placement OL DEP-006,DEP-007 MUST ;; NuGet and npm placement as the package-management rule requires (central versions, versionless references). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep025.no-force OL DEP-025 MUST_NOT ;; Never use --force or --legacy-peer-deps merely to bypass incompatible peers; resolve the actual problem. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ad-scanner OL WF-020,GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; After a scanner finding do not automatically replace or upgrade unrelated packages. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.remove-unused-dep EX DEP-001 MUST ;; Remove dependencies no longer used when part of the current change and safe to verify; leave no dead references. ;; = ;; Safe to verify. ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov014.ad-no-unrelated-cleanup OL GOV-014 MUST_NOT ;; No unrelated dependency cleanup during a narrow task. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ad-report EX DEP-004 MUST ;; Report package, version, license, vulnerability/deprecation result, target project and approvals obtained or pending. ;; = ;; none ;; Report fields not in the oracle.

C gov017.ad-request-template OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decision Request fields: title, Context, Options (2-3 with trade-offs), Recommendation, Blocked, Proceeding with. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.ad-headless OL GOV-017 MUST ;; In autonomous/headless runs list unresolved Decision Requests in the final report instead of deciding. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C x.ad-adr-record EX GOV-017,ARC-020 MUST ;; Record an approved decision as an ADR at docs/decisions/NNNN-<kebab-title>.md (Status/Approved by, Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives considered), creating docs/decisions/ with the first ADR. ;; = ;; Approved decision. ;; ADR obligation not in the oracle.
C x.ad-stratified-decision-files EX GOV-017 MUST ;; Update the decision file at the level the decision belongs to (frame style rule, decisions.md, frontend stack rule), never a single cross-level register. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta recording rule.
C gov007.ad-product-sources OL GOV-007,GOV-021 MUST ;; Product behaviour or tunable decisions update SPECIFICATION.md/CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, then custom-settings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ad-summary-line EX GOV-017 MUST ;; Record the change as a decision summary line pointing to the ADR; do not restate rules that live elsewhere. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.
C gov006.ad-declared-property OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A changed declared property affecting observable behaviour (e.g. string comparison) also needs product approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.adr-report EX WF-009 MUST ;; Report the decision, ADR path, updated decision files and follow-up work. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

114 DU ;; Anti-pattern list restating owner rules (FE-001, FE-003, FE-007, DEP-015, FE-012, FE-008, SEC-005, FE-009, FE-004), captured at frontend.md, framework.md, frontend-stack.md and security.md.

C fe007.ng-shared OL FE-007,ARC-027 MUST ;; Directories only with meaningful code; a feature owns its UI and data access; move code to shared only when it genuinely crosses features. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe001.ng-no-ngmodules OL FE-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce NgModules for ordinary feature work unless an integration or legacy dependency requires them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-component-roles EX FE-002 DEFAULT ;; Route-level page components coordinate UI behaviour; reusable presentation components take explicit inputs and emit meaningful events. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.ng-computed-over-effect EX FE-004 AVOID ;; Use computed for derived state; avoid effect() when computed, template binding or explicit event handling is clearer. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C fe004.ng-rxjs-fits OL FE-004 DEFAULT ;; RxJS fits HttpClient, debounced search, switchMap cancellation, combining async sources and event streams. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe012.ng-takeuntil OL FE-012 MUST ;; Manual subscriptions in components/services use takeUntilDestroyed() (or DestroyRef) to tie lifetime to the owner. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.ng-api-models OL FE-003 MUST ;; Use frontend API models matching the published HTTP contract. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe008.ng-class-reason OL FE-008 DEFAULT ;; Prefer functional interceptors; add a class-based one only with a reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe009.ng-central-parsing OL FE-009 MUST ;; Centralize ProblemDetails parsing/mapping (e.g. error interceptor plus mapping helper). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.ng-ux OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Frontend token attachment, authenticated state, hidden actions and navigation guards are UX; server semantics are authoritative. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.ng-reactive OL FE-010 DEFAULT ;; Reactive forms suit non-trivial forms needing explicit state, validation and testability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-no-duplicate-domain-rule EX FE-010,API-010 MUST_NOT ;; Keep request mapping explicit; do not duplicate complex domain rules in TypeScript unless the UI needs an equivalent user-facing rule. ;; = ;; UI needs it. ;; Not in the oracle.
C fe006.ng-escalation OL FE-006,DEP-015 DEFAULT ;; State escalation: component state → signals → feature service/store → RxJS composition → a state library only when demonstrated complexity needs it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ng-material-consistent EX DEP-014 DEFAULT ;; Use Material components consistently for common primitives when they satisfy the requirement; do not wrap every component without a reason. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf016.ng-generated OL WF-016 MUST ;; Keep generated OpenAPI clients separate from handwritten code and regenerate when the contract changes. ;; = ;; Client generation adopted. ;;
C x.ng-test-targets EX TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Frontend test targets: meaningful component behaviour, validation, request mapping, important route/auth behaviour, complex reactive state with the configured runner; E2E covers a few important workflows. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C tst003.ng-no-internals OL TST-003,TST-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not test framework internals or duplicate the same behaviour at every level. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.ng-xss-context OL WF-020,SEC-003 MUST ;; Review deliberate sanitizer bypasses and direct DOM manipulation with untrusted content; ordinary template binding is not automatically XSS. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run001.ng-no-premature OL RUN-001,FE-005 DEFAULT ;; Do not prematurely optimize; lazy loading and sensible rendering first; memoization/virtual scrolling/change-detection work after a real need. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/skills/api-versioning/SKILL.md ;; Knowledge skill (technique only).
@scope on-demand knowledge skill api-versioning (backend)
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [arc026.av-contract]
12 NN ;; Heading.
14 OL [api013.av-when]
16 NN ;; Heading.
18 OL [api015.av-strategy]
20 NN ;; Heading.
22-35 NN ;; Setup code example.
37 NN ;; Heading.
39-52 NN ;; Versioned controller example.
54 NN ;; Descriptive statement.
56 NN ;; Heading.
58 OL [api014.av-breaking]
60 NN ;; Heading.
62 MX [x.av-docs-per-version,api016.av-doc-match,x.av-tests] ;; Per-version Swagger documents and version-difference test guidance are added; documentation matching routing and not overriding HTTP semantics restates API-016/API-003.
64 NN ;; Heading.
66 OL [api013.av-anti,arc010.av-no-minimal,arc026.av-no-dup-models,api022.av-no-silent-removal,api015.av-no-mixing]

C arc026.av-contract OL ARC-026,API-013,DEP-017 MUST ;; Versioning belongs to the API contract, not the use-case layer or domain model; adopting it is Reserved; package only after adoption; deprecation procedure in development-workflow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.av-when OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; Versioning pays off for non-atomic client upgrades, coexisting generations, public APIs, expected breaking changes, migration windows; do not add v1 automatically for co-deployed apps. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.av-strategy OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; URL-segment versioning by default; header or query versioning when requirements justify them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.av-breaking OL API-014 MUST ;; Treat removed/changed fields, changed required input, incompatible semantics, removed endpoints and incompatible documented HTTP behaviour as breaking; compilation does not decide compatibility; consider client generation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.av-docs-per-version EX API-016 DEFAULT ;; Generate separate or clearly grouped Swagger documents per supported version. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api016.av-doc-match OL API-016,API-003 MUST ;; Versioned documentation matches runtime routing and metadata; version changes never override normal HTTP semantics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.av-tests EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test meaningful version differences (routing, shapes, deprecated versions still working, unsupported-version behaviour, intended shared behaviour) without duplicating identical tests per version. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api013.av-anti OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; No versioning without a compatibility requirement and no new version for every implementation change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.av-no-minimal OL ARC-010 MUST_NOT ;; No Minimal API version groups in a Controller project. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc026.av-no-dup-models OL ARC-026 MUST_NOT ;; No domain models duplicated per version. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api022.av-no-silent-removal OL API-022,API-014 MUST_NOT ;; No incompatible edits to an existing version and no silent removal of deprecated versions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.av-no-mixing OL API-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not mix URL, header and query versioning without a concrete reason. ;; = ;; none ;;
